Ezra Morrison is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Computer Science at Western Washington University.
He and Dr. Aiemjoy jointly lead the UC Davis Seroepidemiology Research Group (UCD-SeRG),
contributing expertise in statistical methods for seroepidemiology research.
